SELECT c.course_code, AVG(g.score) AS avg_score FROM courses c JOIN grades g ON c.course_id = g.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id;

SELECT g.student_id, s.full_name, AVG(g.score) AS avg_score
FROM grades g
JOIN students s ON g.student_id = s.student_id
GROUP BY g.student_id
ORDER BY avg_score DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(grade) LIKE '%A%' THEN 'A'
        WHEN LOWER(grade) LIKE '%B%' THEN 'B'
        WHEN LOWER(grade) LIKE '%C%' THEN 'C'
        WHEN LOWER(grade) LIKE '%D%' THEN 'D'
        WHEN LOWER(grade) LIKE '%F%' THEN 'F'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS grade_band,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM grades
GROUP BY grade_band;

SELECT 
    r.region_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct)) AS total_completed_sales_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY r.region_name;

SELECT 
    p.category AS category,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
FROM returns
GROUP BY reason
ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM appointments GROUP BY status;

SELECT h.city, AVG(t.cost) AS avg_cost
FROM hospitals h
JOIN doctors d ON h.hospital_id = d.hospital_id
JOIN appointments a ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id
JOIN treatments t ON a.appointment_id = t.appointment_id
GROUP BY h.city;

SELECT specialty, COUNT(*) AS appointment_count
FROM doctors
JOIN appointments ON doctors.doctor_id = appointments.doctor_id
WHERE appointments.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY specialty
ORDER BY appointment_count DESC;
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patients GROUP BY city;
